building: Lawson Hall / Richard and Patricia Lawson Computer Science Building

changes.action: Resized the existing display backing to 16 x 9 ft and modeled a 4 x 4 arrangement of sixteen 46-inch display modules with narrow bezels.
changes.evidence: Purdue CS 2011 article reports 16 x 9 ft, sixteen 46-inch LCD monitors, 4 x 4 layout.
changes.limits: This is the documented 2011 installation; current hardware/content is not verified. Screen graphics and module placement within the wall are illustrative.

changes.action: Added a stainless-steel helical schematic, 3.046 m high in the saved mesh, matching Purdue's reported 10 ft overall height within 0.002 m.
changes.evidence: Purdue CS reports John Mishler's brushed/textured stainless-steel Echo Spiral was installed inside the lobby directly in front of the main entrance; 2006 Purdue account describes the spiral and two-piece installation.
changes.limits: The source does not provide a dimensioned sculpture drawing. The tube/spiral profile, base and exact floor location are schematic, not a reconstruction of the sculpture's exact surface.

changes.action: Added an illustrative glass display case and two touchscreen kiosks.
changes.evidence: Purdue's 2006 building dedication describes interactive direction/information touchscreens and a display case for Purdue memorabilia in the Kurz Lobby.
changes.limits: Exact number, placement, dimensions and present condition are not established by the sources; all fixture geometry and layout are illustrative.

changes.feature: Roof, exterior shell and stairs evidence metadata
changes.action: Tagged eleven roof/shell/vertical envelope objects as schematic and height/current-roof unverified. Tagged each of the 57 first-floor stair mesh pieces and six landing meshes as schematic, with vertical continuity unverified.
changes.evidence: Purdue's available first-floor plan gives stair locations only. Checked photo/plan sources do not provide measured elevations or complete current upper-floor plans.
changes.limits: No shell, roof, penthouse or equipment height geometry was changed or claimed as measured. Overall model Z maximum remains 21.30 m, unverified. No continuous floor-to-floor stair path is claimed.

changes.action: Reopened the saved source and refreshed exterior, whole first-floor cutaway, entry/lobby detail and Commons video-wall detail renders with controlled lighting. The cutaway uses a render-only neutral gray floor for contrast.
changes.limits: Temporary cameras, lights and floor-material override are not saved into the building asset. The cutaway represents only the plan-derived first floor.

remaining_uncertainty: No measured or current source establishes the whole-shell height, roof/penthouse/equipment elevations, or upper-floor window positions.
Exterior opening cadence/material dimensions are simplified and unmeasured; facade rhythm was not changed without elevation evidence.
No upper-floor plans were available. Stair pieces are illustrative and do not demonstrate continuous vertical circulation.
Only L1 interiors are modeled from the available first-floor plan. Furniture sizes/placements, display fixture positions and sculpture profile remain schematic.
